
== lone produce
-- stroke 1
   bin 101 SYN-LONE +1 produce_tick epoch=0
   seat GLP_1 bin=101 count=11 hold=0 holdPart=""
-- stroke 3 (past the pack, no strict pack)
   bin 101 SYN-LONE +3 produce_tick epoch=0
   seat GLP_1 bin=101 count=14 hold=0 holdPart=""

== lone produce, strict pack
-- stroke 5 (2 fit, 3 held)
   bin 111 SYN-STRICT +2 produce_tick epoch=0
   seat GSP_1 bin=111 count=12 hold=3 holdPart="SYN-STRICT"

== LH/RH, two produce spots of two parts
-- stroke 1
   bin 121 SYN-LH +1 produce_tick epoch=0
   bin 122 SYN-RH +1 produce_tick epoch=0
   seat GLR_LH bin=121 count=1 hold=0 holdPart=""
   seat GLR_RH bin=122 count=1 hold=0 holdPart=""
-- stroke 2
   bin 121 SYN-LH +2 produce_tick epoch=0
   bin 122 SYN-RH +2 produce_tick epoch=0
   seat GLR_LH bin=121 count=3 hold=0 holdPart=""
   seat GLR_RH bin=122 count=3 hold=0 holdPart=""

== A/B consume pair
-- stroke 4, A lit
   bin 131 SYN-AB -4 consume_tick epoch=0
   seat GAB_A bin=131 count=46 hold=0 holdPart=""
   seat GAB_B bin=132 count=50 hold=0 holdPart=""
-- stroke 3, both dark (fall-through)
   bin 131 SYN-AB -3 ab_fallthrough epoch=0
   seat GAB_A bin=131 count=43 hold=0 holdPart=""
   seat GAB_B bin=132 count=50 hold=0 holdPart=""

== press-index front beside a dark pair
-- stroke 2
   bin 141 SYN-PI +2 produce_tick epoch=0
   bin 142 SYN-PIQ -2 ab_fallthrough epoch=0
   seat GPI_F bin=141 count=7 hold=0 holdPart=""
   seat GPI_QA bin=142 count=38 hold=0 holdPart=""
   seat GPI_QB bin=143 count=40 hold=0 holdPart=""

== consume with a lineside pile; consume with no cart
-- stroke 10 (7 off the pile, 3 off the cart)
   bin 151 SYN-PILE -3 consume_tick epoch=0
   pile GCP_1 SYN-PILE active drained=7
   seat GCP_1 bin=151 count=37 hold=0 holdPart=""
   seat GCP_NOCART bin=- count=0 hold=0 holdPart=""
   ledger GCP_NOCART catid="9100" part="SYN-PILE2" no-cart qty=10 strokes=1
-- stroke 5
   bin 151 SYN-PILE -5 consume_tick epoch=0
   seat GCP_1 bin=151 count=32 hold=0 holdPart=""
   seat GCP_NOCART bin=- count=0 hold=0 holdPart=""
   ledger GCP_NOCART catid="9100" part="SYN-PILE2" no-cart qty=15 strokes=2

== consume of a kit (two manifest lines)
-- stroke 4
   bin 161 SYN-KIT -4 consume_tick epoch=0
   seat GKT_1 bin=161 count=26 hold=0 holdPart=""

== station counter
-- cell stroke 2
   bin 173 SYN-ST1 -2 consume_tick epoch=0
   seat GST_1 bin=171 count=40 hold=0 holdPart=""
   seat GST_2 bin=172 count=40 hold=0 holdPart=""
   seat GST_CELL bin=173 count=38 hold=0 holdPart=""
-- station stroke 3
   bin 171 SYN-ST1 -3 consume_tick epoch=0
   bin 172 SYN-ST2 -3 consume_tick epoch=0
   seat GST_1 bin=171 count=37 hold=0 holdPart=""
   seat GST_2 bin=172 count=37 hold=0 holdPart=""
   seat GST_CELL bin=173 count=38 hold=0 holdPart=""

== held, off-plan, today's and a release
-- held stroke 3
   seat GHO_1 bin=181 count=40 hold=0 holdPart=""
   seat GHO_2 bin=182 count=40 hold=0 holdPart=""
   ledger cell catid="9001" part="" held qty=3 strokes=1
-- off-plan stroke 2 of B
   bin 182 SYN-HO-B -2 consume_tick epoch=0
   seat GHO_1 bin=181 count=40 hold=0 holdPart=""
   seat GHO_2 bin=182 count=38 hold=0 holdPart=""
   ledger cell catid="9001" part="" held qty=3 strokes=1
   ledger GHO_1 catid="9002" part="SYN-HO-B" off-plan qty=2 strokes=1
-- today's stroke 1 of A
   bin 181 SYN-HO-A -1 consume_tick epoch=0
   seat GHO_1 bin=181 count=39 hold=0 holdPart=""
   seat GHO_2 bin=182 count=38 hold=0 holdPart=""
   ledger cell catid="9001" part="" held qty=3 strokes=1
   ledger GHO_1 catid="9002" part="SYN-HO-B" off-plan qty=2 strokes=1
   ledger GHO_2 catid="9003" part="SYN-HO-A" no-cart qty=1 strokes=1
-- the held draw released under A
   bin 181 SYN-HO-A -3 consume_tick epoch=0
   seat GHO_1 bin=181 count=36 hold=0 holdPart=""
   seat GHO_2 bin=182 count=38 hold=0 holdPart=""
   ledger cell catid="9001" part="" held qty=3 strokes=1
   ledger GHO_1 catid="9002" part="SYN-HO-B" off-plan qty=2 strokes=1
   ledger GHO_2 catid="9003" part="SYN-HO-A" no-cart qty=1 strokes=1
   ledger GHO_2 catid="9001" part="SYN-HO-A" held qty=3 strokes=1
